vision.name: Blue Stylish Pose
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(Limit 1 per deck. As an action, you may banish this card from your hand to search your discard pile or Banished Zone for an Ally and play it.)
POWER: Search your Life Deck or discard pile for an Ally and play it. Raise an Ally to its highest power stage. You may use a critical damage effect.
(Created by Matt Tambor, OP1 North Kai Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP1); landscape Setup layout; red crest set symbol; prints a design credit line; same card as S18 PRO_P7 (different art/frame)
